title: The Baire product theorem for Choquet spaces
authors: Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz
summary: An arbitrary Baire topological space times a space with a winning full-history second-player Banach–Mazur strategy is Baire. A disjoint dense rectangle tree yields, for each prescribed nonempty open fiber region, a dense Gδ set of parameters with a common-point fiber witness for every countable dense-open product family. An explicit shrinking-ball strategy establishes alpha-favorability of complete metric spaces. Empty factors and legal-play existence are treated explicitly. This is classical mathematics, not a novelty or determinacy claim.
